notes.title: Mewseum: Masterpieces is available now!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41581623/b81607bb25d00492d972a9bac1ac8f1a2616d8f8.png[/img]

Come to the newest art exhibition at the Cat Museum. Solve the puzzles and reveal beautiful masterpieces where cats are the protagonists in the history of art.

[b]Enjoy the game launch with a special discount![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3417690/Mewseum_Masterpieces/

Or, if you're an art lover and want to collect exhibitions, take advantage of the special bundle with the game Proverbs, where your goal is to piece together a single enormous mosaic inspired by Bruegel’s Netherlandish Proverbs, where every solved region reveals hidden wisdom.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50936/Paintings__Puzzles/

Get both games together to secure an even bigger discount!

Thank you!
Rodrigo Albuquerque

notes.title: New release coming soon...
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41581623/b81607bb25d00492d972a9bac1ac8f1a2616d8f8.png[/img]
[h1]🎨 My new game, Mewseum: Masterpieces, is coming soon![/h1]
If you enjoyed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2614980/Square_Logic/][b]Square Logic[/b][/url], you’ll probably love this new release! In Mewseum: Masterpieces, every puzzle you solve reveals a piece of a famous painting, reimagined in the charming feline universe.

The game will feature relaxing puzzles with easy and medium difficulty levels, perfect for anyone looking to have fun without pressure.

I’m working hard to bring a playable demo soon. Help support the game by adding it to your wishlist and following the game on Steam to stay updated on all news and the official launch.

Thank you, and see you soon! 🐾
Rodrigo Albuquerque

🌟Add to your Wishlist and Follow the game Now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3417690/Mewseum_Masterpieces

notes.title: CatMelon - Suika Game is available now!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41581623/3595221e55d53c6642c582b8a8a7ebc58e76679c.png[/img]

In CatMelon, the goal is to match adorable fruit-dressed cats to create increasingly larger versions — all the way up to the legendary CatMelon! The bigger the cat, the higher the score!

To increase the challenge (and the fun!), you’ll have two strategic helpers: the “bath” and “shake the box” features. The game also includes two additional modes to test your skills and see how far you can go.

[b]Develop your best strategy to stay at the top of the ranking![/b]

[b]Click below to learn more and take advantage of the launch discount![/b]
